run_training_script: run the CogVideoX image-to-video LoRA training script with pretrained model and dataset arguments
create_VideoDataset: create a VideoDataset that loads video-caption pairs from a local folder or HuggingFace hub
build_lora_optimizer: build an AdamW, Adam, or Prodigy optimizer for the transformer LoRA parameters
test_validation_inference: test the trained model by running validation inference with prompts and reference images
summarize_model_card: summarize the trained LoRA model by generating a model card with validation videos and usage instructions
